title: What Is Cherry Picking — Explained in 2 Minutes
skills: identify cherry picking in arguments and research
evaluate whether claims account for relevant conflicting evidence
use balanced evidence when constructing and assessing arguments
alignment_note: Explains cherry picking as the selective use of evidence that supports a preferred conclusion while ignoring relevant contradictory information. Supports logical-fallacy recognition, source evaluation, argument analysis, research literacy, and responsible evidence use across high school English courses.
